7/7/16
Shanghai Municipal Council.
July 7th 1916.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

Sir,
It is rumoured that General Yang will soon resign
and that a civilian will be appointed Governor of Shanghai.
The native gentry have held a meeting and have
decided to petition the Government and request to have
the Nantao police placed under local control as they
were at the time of the first revolution.
It is reported that General Yang has informed
Chiangchun Feng that General Leo Yung Ziang
is conspiring with the Manchu Restoration Party.
It is rumoured that Tong Hyang Ming
has disappeared from Hunan but complete quiet
prevails in that province.
The three evening trains from Nanking failed to
arrive yesterday. It is said that the heavy rain
has caused some damage to the line near Chinkiang
and that trains could not pass that point.
It is reported that Huang Hsin arrived here
on 6th inst by the Shidzuoka Maru from Japan.
He is said to be staying in Frenchtown. He passed
down Nanking Road on car 584.

Your Obedient Servant,
McMustrine
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.
pages.zh:
437
16/7/7
上海工部局。
1916年7月7日。
（印：上海工部局）
警务处，
（侦探股）

先生：

据传杨将军即将辞职，并将任命一位文官担任上海道尹。本地士绅已举行会议，决定向政府请愿，要求将南市警察置于地方管辖之下，如同第一次革命时期那样。

据悉，杨将军已告知冯国璋，李永祥将军正与满清复辟党 conspiring（共谋）。

据传唐仰明已从湖南失踪，但该省目前完全平静。

昨日，从南京开出的三趟晚班列车未能抵达。据说大雨导致镇江附近的铁路线受到一定损坏，列车无法通过该地段。

据报道，黄兴于本月6日乘“静冈丸”轮从日本抵达此地。据悉他现住在法租界。他曾乘坐584号电车沿南京路下行。

您顺从的仆人，
麦克马斯特林
总探长

警务处总监 上尉
